decisive_items: irregularly enhancing mass in the right ear canal, middle ear cavity, and mastoid air cells
erosive changes of the skull base and extension into the right middle cranial fossa
response.rationale: An enhancing destructive temporal bone mass with skull-base erosion, intracranial extension, and profound sensorineural hearing loss favors middle ear carcinoma over cholesteatoma, which is typically non-enhancing and causes conductive rather than profound sensorineural loss.

rejected.why: Necrotizing otitis externa is unlikely in a young, immunocompetent patient with painless otorrhea and predominant middle ear/mastoid involvement rather than a painful external canal infection.
